name: Stephen Báthory
role: Ruler of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth from 1576 to 1586
contribution: King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania as well as Prince of Transylvania, after previously being Voivode of Transylvania.

checks.lead: Stephen Báthory (Hungarian: Báthory István; Polish: Stefan Batory; Lithuanian: ; 27 September 1533 – 12 December 1586) was King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania as well as Prince of Transylvania (1576–1586), after previously being Voivode of Transylvania (1571–1576).
